apps.name: The Game of Life 2+ (Apple Arcade)
apps.localizedDescription:
Pocket Gamer award winner The Game of Life 2+ arrives on Apple Arcade, with exclusive jobs and a brand-new outfit for Apple Arcade players! 

The official sequel to the world-famous board game, The Game of Life 2+ opens up a thousand lives to live! Will you seek out your soulmate or stay single? Have kids or adopt a kitten? Dive right into your dream career or switch it up? The choice is yours!

Exclusive to Apple Arcade players, dress up in the P.E.G. outfit – that’s the Perfect Electronic Gamer outfit, which turns your peg into a sleek robot ready to calculate the best route to victory. 

Plus, enjoy even more possibilities with ten different job titles exclusive to Apple Arcade! Become a Zookeeper, a knight’s Squire or a Pumpkin C
